items.title: Joseph Bentley (Gibson Brass Band) Interview
items.q: Played with Nat Doe's in the Middle West.

ctx.x: Well, after the old man died, well, his son took the band over. The band is under the name of—the band goes under the name of George Williams and his orchestra now.

Yeah. It was Claiborne Williams and his orchestra. That's right, yeah. Mm-hmm. They're still playing today. Mm-hmm. Yes, they're playing. And what other bands have you played with? Played with Nat Doe's in the Middle West. You played in the Middle West? No. Did you play any other instruments besides trumpet or—? No. You've always played trumpet? No, I've played trumpet. How long have you been with this band, the Gibson band? About a month now.
